name: Ensemble Tracking with dtiInit
summary: Generates an ensemble whole-brain tractogram from a dtiInit output with MRtrix 0.2.12, combining tensor, CSD deterministic and CSD probabilistic tracking over several lmax and curvature values into one .tck.
description: Implements Ensemble Tractography (Takemura et al. 2016): fits CSD at every even lmax up to max_lmax, tracks with DT_STREAM, SD_STREAM and SD_PROB over the chosen curvature values from white-matter and corpus-callosum seeds (plus optional optic radiation and visual tracts), and concatenates all candidates into track.tck. Use it to produce a rich candidate tractogram, for example for LiFE or COMMIT filtering. Requires a FreeSurfer run of the same subject for the masks. num_or_fibers above 25 makes the App exit.

inputs.description: dtiInit output; the aligned DWI, bvals and bvecs listed in dt6.json are tracked.
FreeSurfer recon-all output of the same subject, used to build white-matter, corpus callosum and other seed/ROI masks.

outputs.description: Ensemble tractogram (track.tck) concatenating all algorithm, lmax and curvature runs.

(despite the odd output directory name "mask_dwi") A brain mask created from freesurfer aparc+aseg converted to .nii.gz using input t1 as output template volume (--temp). It uses all white matter segments (--match 2 41 16 17 28 60 51 53 12 52 13 18 54 50 11 251 252 253 254 255 10 49 46 7) see FreeSurferColorLUT
